title: Complete your profile
note: These are the details that registration and application forms ask for most often. Fill in what you have; leave the rest empty and add it later.

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Mobile phone number
fields.hint: e.g. 138 0013 8000; spaces and dashes are fine

fields.name: address
fields.label: Postal address
fields.hint: On one line, down to the house or unit number

fields.name: emergency contact
fields.label: Who should be contacted in an emergency?
fields.hint: Name and relationship, e.g. Sam Roe (father)
